details: Read existing web layouts/publicpages/auth boundaries and reuse CSS styles, no framework/newdependency. Do not alter shared style/header/layout/viewer files, manifests, auth/deploy. Scoped new page/componentCSS only. Service peer owns POST /api/lab. Agreed API: start request {action:'start',template:'free_fall'|'projectile'|'ramp'|'pendulum',mystery:boolean}; start response status:'ok',sessionId:string,template,mode:'mystery-g'|'normal', observations:[{time_s,position_m}], observationHash:string, source:'simulated', units:{time:'s',position:'m'}, limitations:string[]. Mystery start MUST NOT include gravity,seed,privateSetup,truth,error/meta that leaks g. Normal start may include explicit source-labelled gravity; do not depend on it. Fit request {action:'fit',sessionId}; only ballistic fit allowed; response status:'ok',fit actualS11response, reveal gravityquantity or equivalent {gravity,unit,uncertainty,source:'simulated'} matching session. Fit errors are status:'error',error:{code:readable}. UI starts blank, clears previous outputs on run/toggle/template change, never embeds hiddenworld constants/seed; does not calculate authored gravity or fabricate fit. DisableFit untilstartsuccess, nonballisticexplanation. Handlepending/errors/stale responses/aborts, no rawJSONprivatepayload dumping. Page no sessionauth change; API is loopbackdev-only synthetic. Read actual service once available but don't edit. Tests should verify behavior at small pure component state/contract seam not meregrep ifpossible; no testdependencyinstall. Send callback settledresponse mismatch immediately. Parent owns localserver/browser and fullbuild serialization; do NOT run heavybuild concurrently.
